body:
i was diagnosed with colon cancer in jan. 2006 and threw my treatments was prescribed high doses of oxycotin and percrocet but during my surgery was given morphine for the and enjoyed the rush it gave me but as a side effect of the surgery radiation and chemo treatments i have a bad case of diarrhea that they say will last for more than a year so i have been prescribed paregoric which is an old school treatment for the condition that is very strong and the only 2 chemicals in it are opium and 90 proof alcohol so what i did is put a small amount of the paregoric in a bowl light it with a match so all the alcohol burns out and all im left with is pure opium which i can inject and im left with the closest rush to morphine i can find so good luck on getting a prescription of paregoric and it is kinda hard to find
